section_1_cloze.passage:
I used to be the most determined resolution-maker. I always picked big [41] , like losing 50 pounds and running a marathon! However, I often [42] out of willpower by February or March, and [43] quietly back into my old habits.
Two years ago, my life took a dramatic [44] when I was diagnosed with two types of cancer. The health crisis completely [45] my perspective on my life. Before, I always felt like I was failing somewhere, but now simply being alive felt like a huge [46] .
That was when I [47] to make small goals instead of resolutions. For instance, I started by [48] more fruits and vegetables daily. After a few months, this became a(n) [49] habit, so I switched my little goal to drinking more water and less soda. I also challenged myself to [50] something new at the gym, like rowing machine. Last year, I jokingly decided that I wanted to stay well enough to avoid our insurance's upfront medical costs. [51] , I succeeded, largely due to the healthy habits I'd developed.
The thing about almost losing your [52] is that it really makes you realize how fragile and [53] it is. Cancer gave me a sense of [54] and motivated me to find a better way to feel successful. January 1st is just a day, and it's not special. [55] , you can make any day when you decide to be a better person a special day, regardless of what the calendar says.

questions.explanation: 上下文表明作者以前常常定下宏大的“新年决心(resolutions)”，比如减肥50磅或者跑马拉松，这些都属于宏大的“目标(goals)”。选项C最符合语境。易错点：容易误选D(moments)，但结合具体例子(减肥、马拉松)，这些需要长期努力，属于目标。
questions.supplement:
A(roles)：语境句：Education plays vital roles in personal development. 固定搭配：play a role, take on a role
B(issues)：语境句：We need to address these environmental issues immediately. 固定搭配：environmental issues, resolve an issue
C(goals)：语境句：Setting realistic goals is the first step to success. 固定搭配：achieve a goal, set a goal
D(moments)：语境句：He captured the beautiful moments of the wedding. 固定搭配：at the moment, for a moment

questions.explanation: 根据后文的“back into my old habits”，说明作者到了二三月份时意志力就“不足/耗尽”了。原卷此处搭配略显特殊(正常多用 ran out of)，在给定选项中，fall short 意为“未达到、不足”，与 out of willpower 结合理解为“意志力跟不上/不足以支撑”。A最契合失败的语境。易错点：学生可能对 fall short 的用法不熟而乱选。
questions.supplement:
A(fell short)：语境句：The hotel's service fell short of our expectations. 固定搭配：fall short of, fall short
B(fell behind)：语境句：If you don't study hard, you will fall behind your classmates. 固定搭配：fall behind in, fall behind schedule
C(stayed awake)：语境句：She drank coffee to stay awake during the night shift. 固定搭配：stay awake, keep awake
D(stayed up)：语境句：He stayed up late preparing for the final exam. 固定搭配：stay up late, stay up doing sth

questions.explanation: 作者意志力耗尽后，“悄悄地滑落回(slid back into)”以前的老习惯中。slide back into sth 形象地表达了不知不觉退回到不良习惯的状态。A、C、D动作性不符合“悄悄退回”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(looked)：语境句：She looked closely at the painting. 固定搭配：look forward to, look into
B(slid)：语境句：He slowly slid the letter into his pocket. 固定搭配：slide into, slide back into
C(ran)：语境句：We ran out of gas on the highway. 固定搭配：run out of, run into
D(fought)：语境句：They fought bravely against the invaders. 固定搭配：fight for, fight against

questions.explanation: 两年前作者被诊断出两种癌症，生活发生了戏剧性的“转折(turn)”。take a dramatic turn 是固定表达，意为“发生戏剧性转折”。
questions.supplement:
A(rest)：语境句：You look tired; you should take a rest. 固定搭配：take a rest, have a rest
B(risk)：语境句：He took a huge risk by investing all his money. 固定搭配：take a risk, at the risk of
C(pause)：语境句：There was a brief pause in the conversation. 固定搭配：give sb pause, without a pause
D(turn)：语境句：His career took a dramatic turn when he moved to New York. 固定搭配：take a turn for the better, in turn

questions.explanation: 这场健康危机彻底“重塑/改变(reshaped)”了作者对生活的看法(perspective)。B(预测)、C(误导)、D(打扰)都不符合“生病改变三观”的逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(reshaped)：语境句：The Internet has totally reshaped the way we communicate. 固定搭配：reshape the future, reshape society
B(predicted)：语境句：Experts predicted that the economy would recover soon. 固定搭配：predict the future, predict the outcome
C(misguided)：语境句：He was misguided by the false information on the website. 固定搭配：misguide public opinion, highly misguided
D(disturbed)：语境句：The loud noise disturbed my train of thought. 固定搭配：disturb the peace, deeply disturbed

questions.explanation: 前文提到作者以前总觉得自己“在某些方面很失败(failing)”，现在仅仅是活着就感觉是一种巨大的“成功(success)”。利用前后文的 failing 与 success 形成对比。
questions.supplement:
A(change)：语境句：We need to make a change to improve the current situation. 固定搭配：make a change, undergo a change
B(success)：语境句：Her new book turned out to be a great success. 固定搭配：achieve success, a huge success
C(contribution)：语境句：He made a significant contribution to science. 固定搭配：make a contribution to, outstanding contribution
D(opportunity)：语境句：Don't miss this golden opportunity to study abroad. 固定搭配：seize the opportunity, miss the opportunity

questions.explanation: 就在那时，作者“决定(decided)”制定小目标而不是宏大的决心。这里表达主观的决定或改变，其他选项不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(pretended)：语境句：He pretended not to hear the teacher's question. 固定搭配：pretend to do sth, pretend ignorance
B(hesitated)：语境句：She hesitated for a moment before answering. 固定搭配：hesitate to do sth, without hesitation
C(decided)：语境句：They finally decided to call off the meeting. 固定搭配：decide to do sth, decide on
D(guessed)：语境句：I guessed the correct answer by luck. 固定搭配：guess what, make a guess

questions.explanation: 结合后面的“more fruits and vegetables daily”可知，这里指的是每天“吃(eating)”更多的水果和蔬菜，这是健康生活常识。
questions.supplement:
A(cooking)：语境句：She enjoys cooking Italian food on weekends. 固定搭配：do the cooking, cook a meal
B(storing)：语境句：Squirrels are busy storing nuts for the winter. 固定搭配：store data, store up
C(delivering)：语境句：The postman is responsible for delivering letters. 固定搭配：deliver a speech, deliver a baby
D(eating)：语境句：Eating a balanced diet is vital for your health. 固定搭配：eat out, eat healthy

questions.explanation: 几个月后，多吃果蔬变成了一个“稳固的(solid)”习惯。solid habit 意为根深蒂固、稳定的习惯。其他选项B(暂时的)、C(偶尔的)、D(独特的)不符合“习惯养成”的结果。
questions.supplement:
A(solid)：语境句：He has acquired a solid foundation in mathematics. 固定搭配：solid foundation, solid evidence
B(temporary)：语境句：This is only a temporary solution to the problem. 固定搭配：temporary relief, temporary job
C(occasional)：语境句：He takes occasional trips to the countryside to relax. 固定搭配：occasional visits, occasional use
D(unique)：语境句：Every individual's fingerprint is entirely unique. 固定搭配：unique feature, unique opportunity

questions.explanation: 作者挑战自己去健身房“尝试(try)”一些新事物，比如划船机。try something new 是固定的交际表达和搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(introduce)：语境句：Allow me to introduce my best friend to you. 固定搭配：introduce sb to sb, introduce a new policy
B(teach)：语境句：Experience will teach you how to deal with difficulties. 固定搭配：teach sb a lesson, teach by example
C(make)：语境句：We can make a difference if we work together. 固定搭配：make a mistake, make a living
D(try)：语境句：You should try to look on the bright side. 固定搭配：try something new, try one's best

questions.explanation: 前句提到作者去年是“半开玩笑地(jokingly)”决定要保持健康以避免医疗费用，结果很大程度上因为养成的健康习惯，作者“令人惊讶地(Surprisingly)”成功了。前后构成一种出乎意料但情理之中的转折。
questions.supplement:
A(Hopefully)：语境句：Hopefully, the weather will clear up by tomorrow. 固定搭配：hopefully we will, look hopefully
B(Eagerly)：语境句：The children waited eagerly for the gifts. 固定搭配：wait eagerly, look forward eagerly
C(Surprisingly)：语境句：Surprisingly, he passed the difficult driving test on his first attempt. 固定搭配：surprisingly good, surprisingly well
D(Interestingly)：语境句：Interestingly, she ended up marrying her high school rival. 固定搭配：interestingly enough, ironically/interestingly

questions.explanation: 文章主线是作者得了癌症，几乎失去了“生命(life)”。这种濒临死亡的体验让作者意识到生命是多么脆弱。
questions.supplement:
A(life)：语境句：The doctor managed to save the patient's life. 固定搭配：lose one's life, save a life
B(confidence)：语境句：The successful presentation greatly boosted her confidence. 固定搭配：build confidence, lose confidence
C(ability)：语境句：She has the amazing ability to learn languages quickly. 固定搭配：have the ability to, to the best of one's ability
D(energy)：语境句：We should take measures to save energy and protect the environment. 固定搭配：save energy, full of energy

questions.explanation: 几乎失去生命让人意识到它是多么脆弱且“珍贵的(precious)”。fragile和precious在这里并列，形容生命的特质。
questions.supplement:
A(desperate)：语境句：The country is in desperate need of medical supplies. 固定搭配：in desperate need, a desperate attempt
B(precious)：语境句：Time is precious, so don't waste it on meaningless things. 固定搭配：precious time, precious memories
C(tough)：语境句：He is going through a really tough time right now. 固定搭配：tough time, tough guy
D(peaceful)：语境句：They lived a peaceful life in a small remote village. 固定搭配：peaceful environment, peaceful resolution

questions.explanation: 癌症给了作者一种“目标感(sense of purpose)”，并激励作者找到更好的方式来感受成功。sense of purpose 意为目标感、意义感，符合激励(motivated)的正向语境。
questions.supplement:
A(guilt)：语境句：He was consumed by a strong sense of guilt for lying. 固定搭配：sense of guilt, feel guilty
B(purpose)：语境句：Volunteering gave her life a renewed sense of purpose. 固定搭配：sense of purpose, on purpose
C(security)：语境句：A stable job can provide you with a sense of security. 固定搭配：sense of security, national security
D(frustration)：语境句：He threw his pen down in frustration when he couldn't solve the math problem. 固定搭配：in frustration, out of frustration

questions.explanation: 前句说1月1日只是普通的一天，并不特别。后句说你可以把任何决定变好的日子变成特别的一天。“事实上(In fact)”起到了进一步解释和强调的作用，符合句间的逻辑递进。
questions.supplement:
A(By accident)：语境句：I found this rare book in the library totally by accident. 固定搭配：happen by accident, discover by accident
B(In addition)：语境句：In addition to French, she also speaks fluent Spanish. 固定搭配：in addition, in addition to
C(By design)：语境句：The trap was set by design rather than by accident. 固定搭配：by design (故意的)
D(In fact)：语境句：He seems harsh, but in fact, he has a very kind heart. 固定搭配：in fact, as a matter of fact

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the northwest region of China, on the edge of the Gobi Desert, lies one of the world's most remarkable collections of Buddhist art — the Mogao Grottoes (石窟).
During the age of the Silk Road, travelers would stop here [56] for safe passage or to give thanks for the journeys safely made. Hundreds of temples worshipping the Buddha [57] into the cliff face at Mogao for a thousand years. Today, nearly 500 of these grotto temples remain, visited by people from around the world. Most temple owners or guardians also had the inside walls and ceilings of their grottoes [58] with religious images and stories. And this tradition extended for more than 1,000 years.
In the murals (壁画) of the Northern Wei period in Dunhuang, Jataka stories are [59] important theme. Jataka stories refer specifically [60] the countless events and experiences in the past lives of Siddhartha Gautama, who would later become the founder of Buddhism. "The Story of the Nine-Colored Deer King" is just one of them. While the mural is not [61] large in size, it holds significant importance in Chinese art history. This artwork takes the form of a long hand scroll with the story unfolding from both ends and [62] in the middle. It consists of multiple scenes describing [63] stages of the story, all connected without any gap to create a complete narrative.
The painting style of the murals changed gradually in the following [64] . So did the content. Instead of religious images and stories sometimes with a romantic touch, the murals began to describe the ordinary life of people working in the fields, hunting, dining, singing and dancing or attending ceremonies for major holidays, [65] was in a more realistic style.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。stop here to pray 意为“停在这里祈祷”，动词不定式作目的状语，表示停下来的目的是为了祈祷。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to pray)：语境句：People gathered in the church to pray for world peace. 固定搭配：pray for, stop to do sth。原词pray其它变形：prayer (n. 祈祷/祷告词), praying (v.-ing/adj. 祈祷的)

questions.explanation: 考查动词的时态和语态。主语是 Hundreds of temples，与 carve (雕刻) 是被动关系。根据上下文，这些寺庙是在“丝绸之路时代(During the age of the Silk Road)”被雕刻的，属于过去的动作，故用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were carved)：语境句：These exquisite statues were carved out of solid rock centuries ago. 固定搭配：carve into, carve out。原词carve其它变形：carving (n. 雕刻品), carver (n. 雕刻家)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句型为 have sth. done (让某事被做)。宾语 the inside walls and ceilings 与 paint 之间是被动关系，故使用过去分词 painted 作宾语补足语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(painted)：语境句：They had their house painted blue before the festival. 固定搭配：have sth painted, paint with。原词paint其它变形：painting (n. 画), painter (n. 画家)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。theme 是可数名词单数，此处泛指“一个重要的主题”，且 important 以元音音素开头，故填不定冠词 an。
questions.supplement: 正确形(an)：语境句：Environmental protection has become an increasingly important theme in modern society. 固定搭配：an important theme, play an important role。变形：a/an/the 根据语境选择

questions.explanation: 考查介词。refer to 是固定搭配，意为“指代，提及，参考”。此处意为“本生故事特指悉达多·乔答摩前世的无数事件和经历”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The term "AI" refers specifically to artificial intelligence. 固定搭配：refer to, refer to A as B

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处修饰形容词 large，需要用副词形式。particularly 意为“特别地，尤其”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(particularly)：语境句：The traffic is particularly heavy on Friday evenings. 固定搭配：particularly important, not particularly。原词particular其它变形：particular (adj. 特定的/挑剔的), in particular (尤其)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处是 with 复合结构 (with + 宾语 + 宾补)。宾语 the story 与 meet 之间是主动关系（故事在中间相遇/交汇），且与前文的 unfolding 并列，故填 meeting。
questions.supplement: 正确形(meeting)：语境句：The two rivers flow downwards, eventually meeting in the valley. 固定搭配：meet with, meet the standard。原词meet其它变形：meeting (n. 会议), met (过去式/过去分词)

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。此处作定语修饰名词 stages，需用形容词形式。various 意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The students come from various backgrounds and cultures. 固定搭配：various kinds of, at various stages。原词vary其它变形：vary (v. 变化), variety (n. 多样性), variable (adj./n. 变量)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。the following centuries 是常见表述，意为“在接下来的几个世纪里”，表示壁画风格的转变是一个漫长的过程，且前文跨度达到1000年，故使用复数。
questions.supplement: 正确形(centuries)：语境句：This ancient temple has survived for many centuries. 固定搭配：in the following centuries, turn of the century。原词century其它变形：centurial (adj. 世纪的)

questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。逗号后是非限制性定语从句，先行词可以是前文提到的壁画内容（或者整个前面的描述），在从句中作主语，故用关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the entrance exam with high marks, which made his parents very proud. 固定搭配：in which, of which
